unique_image_definition: Primary unique count is decoded-pixel SHA-256. JPG and PNG of the same pixels count as one image.

datasets.source_classification_note: Folder names like public_wound_dataset / yolo_real_wound are not trusted. Classification uses generation scripts, manifests, and filename stems. public_sample_* and yolo_real_wound images are PIL drawings from ml/training/download_public_datasets.py.

negative_or_no_injury.note: Empty/missing YOLO labels, blank_skin/dummy_test, or near-uniform pixels.

public_wound_dataset.note: Not YOLO detect. 200 synthetic JPG drawings from ml/training/download_public_datasets.py; 200 PNG masks. Manifest claims Kaggle/Roboflow/WOUNDSEG but images are PIL drawings. Do not count masks as independent training images.

injury_dataset.note: Not YOLO detect. 30 synthetic JPGs + 30 mask PNGs. Manifest: AI-QTriage Synthetic Research Benchmark. Do not count masks as independent training images.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: Every YOLO detect image is synthetic. yolo_injury stems are synthetic_wound_syn_wound_*. yolo_real_wound / public_sample_* come from PIL drawings generated by download_public_datasets.py, while manifests claim Kaggle/Roboflow/WOUNDSEG and the folder is named yolo_real_wound.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Retraining the canonical detector on this data cannot produce a real-injury model. Metrics would describe drawings, not clinical photos.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: yolo_real_wound manifest remaps raw_class=swelling to final_class=wound. Those boxes train the wound class on swelling drawings.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Active runtime classes are cut/bruise/wound from model.names. Training wound on swelling examples makes wound detections untrustworthy.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: ml/training/train_yolo.py prepare_merged_dataset remaps yolo_injury abrasion(2) and laceration(3) to wound(2). The merged wound class is a mix of wound + abrasion + laceration + remapped swelling.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Do not retrain until class definitions are honest. Do not auto-relabel; decide a taxonomy then label to it.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: cut and bruise have too few unique images to train a three-class detector. wound dominates boxes and images.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Do not duplicate existing images to inflate counts. Collect additional unique cut and bruise samples (or drop classes). Current counts cannot support a balanced retrain.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: yolo_real_wound labels put many tiny boxes on a single drawing (max 14 boxes/image; many w=h=0.049). Train has 256 wound boxes on 24 images.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Do not auto-rewrite labels. Review by hand. Fragmented boxes teach wound as a spray of tiny squares, not one lesion.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: yolo_merged train has only 83 unique pixel hashes. That is too small for a production YOLO11 retrain.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Collect more unique images. Do not duplicate JPG/PNG or existing drawings to increase counts.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: raw/synthetic_wound train contains an exact pixel duplicate: syn_wound_0000.jpg == syn_wound_duplicate.jpg. 222 files, 221 unique pixels.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Do not treat the duplicate JPG as an independent sample. Do not copy files to increase counts.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: yolo_real_wound/qc_samples has 38 unlabeled visualization JPGs (bbox overlay + printed class name). public_wound_dataset and injury_dataset include mask PNGs. None of these are extra training images. No JPG/PNG pairs inside yolo_merged splits.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Do not glob qc_samples or masks into train. Do not treat JPG and PNG of the same case as two samples.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: yolo_merged has zero exact pixel-hash or stem leakage across train/val/test. Average-hash still groups 122/123 images together because they are near-identical synthetic canvases. Fake subject_ids do not leak across splits, but they are not real people.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Val/test cannot prove generalization to real injuries. Collect real photos and split by subject. Do not shuffle these drawings and call it a new split.

must_fix_before_retrain.problem: yolo_merged train/val/test have no empty-label negative images. blank_skin.jpg and dummy_test.jpg sit outside splits in yolo_injury.
must_fix_before_retrain.why_must_fix_before_retrain: Without negatives the detector is not trained to abstain on uninjured skin. Add true unlabeled negatives; do not duplicate positives.

near_duplicate_method_note: Exact split leakage uses pixel SHA-256 and stems (none in yolo_merged). Near-identical uses 8x8 average-hash Hamming<=6. On these flat synthetic canvases aHash is weakly discriminative and collapses almost the whole set into one cluster. That is evidence of visual homogeneity, not 122 byte-identical copies.
